Product Details: Turtle Wax Max Power Car Wash 250 ml is engineered to deliver strong, adjustable cleaning performance for effective exterior vehicle maintenance. Built with a 3 Level Cleaning Action formula, this advanced car shampoo allows you to control the cleaning strength through dilution, making it suitable for light maintenance washes as well as tougher dirt removal. The high-foam formula produces thick, rich suds that help lift and separate mud, road grime, dust, traffic film, bird droppings, and other surface contaminants. The foam action enhances coverage across panels and supports smoother washing when used with a wash mitt, sponge, or foam cannon. This helps reduce friction during cleaning while improving overall wash efficiency. Its pH balanced composition ensures safe use on all automotive paint finishes, including clear coats and metallic surfaces. When diluted properly, it cleans thoroughly without aggressively stripping existing wax layers. This makes it suitable for maintaining vehicles that already have protective coatings applied. The adjustable cleaning system provides flexible performance depending on the dilution ratio: Mild dilution for regular weekly washing and light dirt Medium dilution for daily road grime and heavier contamination Strong dilution for stubborn buildup and deep cleaning needs After rinsing, the vehicle surface appears clean, refreshed, and enhanced with visible gloss and clarity. The formula helps maintain paint appearance while supporting routine car care and detailing maintenance. Suitable for cars, SUVs, and other passenger vehicles, Turtle Wax Max Power Car Wash 250 ml can be used with bucket wash methods, foam cannons, or pressure washer systems. Ideal for home users and detailing enthusiasts, it offers controlled cleaning strength combined with paint-safe performance for consistent exterior care.
